key_highlights: ASX slides as Brent oil nears US$100, fuelling RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall
Iron ore under severe pressure – 'drowning, not waving' – weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA perceived to 'choose recession' as sticky inflation from oil shock complicates policy path
Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; fixed mortgage rates inch upward, 5/1 ARM past 7%
Aussie business conditions weakest since pandemic; 'war on equities' narrative gains traction
WA gold sector active: Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway all advancing projects; copper (Flagship) and silver (Patriot) also expanding
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Qantas fires workers with $35M payout
Iran attacks US base in Jordan and ships near Hormuz – geopolitical oil-supply risk elevated
Data centre build-out at coal plants (Powerlink/Origin) raises energy-transition and NSW power-supply concerns
Gas cartel 'breaks as evil Santos burns' – Santos.AX under regulatory/political pressure

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downturn; copper and gold provide partial offset. Flagship adds copper stakes; WA gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) advancing. Patriot locks Peruvian silver.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold/copper juniors offer relative strength but remain high-beta. Diversify away from pure iron-ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as oil-driven inflation rekindles rate-hike fears, compressing net interest margin expectations. Mortgage rates rising; home buyer sentiment collapses, raising NPL concerns.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. Short-term NIM headwinds; medium-term credit-cycle risk if housing downturn deepens. Watch RBA commentary.

sectors.trend: Brent at US$100 on Iran-Hormuz conflict. Santos.AX faces 'gas cartel' backlash. Power giant seeks AI data-centre co-location at coal plants. NSW power-supply adequacy questioned.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from oil/gas price spike but face political/regulatory risk. Utilities (AGL, Origin) see demand upside from data centres but transition-policy risk.

sectors.trend: Austal (AUS.AX) jumps on US$1.9b bid. Qantas (QAN.AX) fires workers, $35M payout signals cost-cutting. Fiji Airways expands via Western Sydney Airport.
sectors.implications: Austal M&A creates consolidation opportunity. Qantas margin pressure continues. Aviation/transport sensitive to oil-at-$100 input costs.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment at new low; business conditions weakest since pandemic. 102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores. Consumer confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW, ICPS, SPG) face occupancy and rental-yield pressure. Consumer discretionary (WES, WBC retail) under pressure. Staples (WES, WES) relatively defensive.

sectors.trend: AI data-centre build-out at coal sites; Bloom Energy joins S&P 500; ATO opens tax fight with Big Tech. 'Human skills' premium in labour market.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data-centre/infrastructure plays (VIX, STO, IAG) benefit from capex cycle. ATO enforcement may hit foreign tech earnings remitted to Australia.

key_themes: Oil-at-$100 / Iran-Hormuz geopolitical risk driving inflation and rate-hike repricing
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 top-weight names
RBA policy dilemma: fight inflation vs. protect growth ('chooses recession')
Housing downturn: collapsing buyer sentiment, rising mortgage rates, NZ crash as warning
WA gold/copper/silver junior-mining activity – sector rotation into precious metals
Data-centre energy demand vs. transition policy tension
China-US/Trump trade friction – 'China runs out of patience'
Business-cycle trough: conditions weakest since pandemic, 'war on equities' narrative

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over refiners; monitor Brent $100–$110 scenario

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into restrictive policy / recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and construction exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives (WES, CSL.AX)
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (NVA.AX, REG.AX) and copper (STO.AX)
Monitor NPL data; reduce bank and REIT exposure; watch NZ house-price crash as leading indicator
Diversify away from China-exposed commodity names; favour domestic-demand plays
Monitor NSW/Queensland energy policy; favour integrated utilities over pure-play renewables

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper miners as iron ore weakens and inflation hedges demand
opportunities.rationale: WA gold pipeline (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway) and Flagship copper expansion offer relative strength; gold benefits from rate-hike/inflation backdrop

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil & gas producers on Brent $100
opportunities.rationale: Iran-Hormuz conflict supports sustained $95–$110 Brent; Santos/woodside benefit despite political headwinds
M&A premium likely; shipbuilding sector benefits from global re-industrialisation

opportunities.recommendation: Favour defensive dividend payers in rate-hike environment
opportunities.rationale: WES, CSL, and consumer staples offer earnings visibility amid business-cycle trough

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning'; China demand weak; China-US tensions add uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and construction names
defensive_moves.rationale: Collapsing home buyer sentiment, rising mortgage rates, NZ crash signal credit-cycle risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as RBA policy uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA 'chooses recession' narrative; rate-hike bets from oil shock create volatility; 4.1–4.35% CD yields offer risk-free return

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Qantas and transport on oil-cost and restructuring risk
defensive_moves.rationale: $35M worker payout signals ongoing margin pressure; oil-at-$100 hits fuel costs

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-at-$100 and Iran-Hormuz risk keep inflation elevated, forcing RBA hawkish bias. Big four banks and iron-ore majors lead declines. Gold/copper miners and energy producers offer relative outperformance. Volatility elevated; expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Structural themes: WA gold/copper pipeline, data-centre capex, re-industrialisation (Austal). Risks: prolonged China slowdown, housing credit cycle, energy-transition policy whiplash. A balanced portfolio tilted to gold, energy, and defensives is prudent.

Brent oil trajectory – $100 sustainability / Hormuz escalation
China iron-ore demand data and trade-policy moves vs Trump
Australian CPI print (inflation stickiness from oil)
WA gold junior drill results (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway)
NSW/Queensland energy policy on data centres
ATO enforcement actions against Big Tech

RBA cash rate and forward curve
CBA.AX, BHP.AX, WES.AX, CSL.AX price action
